plain_english: To leave outer activity, to dwell in noble consciousness-ground — when You show thing-nondifference, waves gone fickle — the goddess grasps maintenance's destruction. Then may she, Yours, Lord, grasp ever my wandering state's undoing.
sanskrit_cite: bahir vṛttiṃ hātuṃ citibhuvam udārāṃ nivasituṃ | sthiteḥ sāṃsārikyāḥ kalayatu vināśaṃ mama sadā
